svg.title: Manish Singh, full stack engineer
svg.desc: The full stack drawn as rock layers: Interface (React, Next.js), Server (Node.js, REST), Data (PostgreSQL, Drizzle, Prisma) and Bedrock (auth, payments, tests). A request drops down a borehole to the data layer and the response rises back up.

g.text: Full stack engineer. I build from the pixel down to the row lock.
React, Next.js, React Native, TypeScript, Tailwind
Node.js, Server Actions, REST, tRPC, Zod
PostgreSQL, Drizzle, Prisma, transactions, row locks
